world.description: the published world fit; what the app reads first

fallback_four_country.description: older four-country files (Australia, Canada, Chile, Portugal), a complete set of their own; read only as a whole set

live.description: recent raw feeds; never harmonized, never mixed with the historical record

mixing_rule: A view may combine files only from ONE dataset (plus 'live', which is never harmonized). Never combine params, calendars or summaries from 'world' with any file from 'fallback_four_country'. If any world file needed by a view fails, either load the whole fallback set (params.json + calendar_raw.parquet + calendar_harmonized.parquet) and say so on screen, or show the view as unavailable. World-only summaries (countries.json, season.json, drift.json, coverage_status.json, validation_points.json) have no fallback equivalent.
